title: Shared data: trusted owners, clone detection, anti-slop baseline
note: Starting points, not pre-approval. Star counts drift; every entry still goes through `vet` before it is offered to the user.

ui.purpose: Stops generic AI-looking interfaces (purple gradients, glass everywhere, pill-shaped everything, same hero on every site).

recommend.why: 9.7k stars, MIT, updated daily. Core rules plus UI and mobile layout. Bundled scripts are local-only. Asks once per session whether to apply rules DURING the build or audit AFTER.

119k stars, MIT, calls itself 'the anti-slop frontend skill'. Heavy: about 1,600 files / 37 MB, with Node scripts that launch headless Chrome locally, so vet returns REVIEW. Pick it when the user wants a full design kit.

code.purpose: Removes AI code slop: needless comments, defensive try/catch on trusted paths, `any` casts, deep nesting.

recommend.why: Cursor's own team kit, 18k stars. Tiny (under 1 KB), diff-scoped, keeps behavior unchanged.
Pairs with the antislop core when it is already installed for UI.

writing.purpose: Removes AI writing tells from copy, docs, READMEs and landing-page text.

recommend.why: 71.9k stars, MIT. Pattern list ranked by strength, keeps meaning intact. Single SKILL.md, no scripts.
19k stars, MIT. Short rule set (about 2.6 KB) with phrase and structure references.
Use instead when the antislop core is already installed; covers UI microcopy too.

entries.why: Full anti-slop system for web UI, a11y, copy and code.
Edit or detect mode for drafts, preserves the writer's voice, 13.7k stars.
Code slop cleanup on a branch diff.
Oxlint rules that catch slop in JS/TS mechanically. The skill itself recommends cloudflare/oxlint-config first.
